title: Green Damask Printed Tray Set with Organiser
description: Nesting printed trays in a sage green and gold damask pattern with cut-out handles, sold with a matching 2-compartment organiser. Shops display it as one complete set for the dining table or gift counter.

title: Black & Silver Glitter Square Tray Set
description: Two square trays with a silver glitter pebble pattern on a black base and a beaded chrome rim. A festive-season favourite for serving sweets and dry fruits, and an easy gift.

title: Elephant & Palace Print Oval Tray Set
description: A pair of oval serving trays with side handles, printed with a Rajasthani palace, a decorated elephant and a gold jharokha on an ivory base, finished with a ribbed gold rim. Sized for a tea set or a festive platter.

title: Marble Flow Gold-Rim Tray Set
description: Square and oval trays with a swirling white, grey and gold marble effect and a hammered gold rim. A modern look that suits corporate gifting and contemporary homes.

title: Mango Wood Tray Collection
description: Handcrafted mango wood trays with natural grain, so every piece is slightly different. Used for tea, coffee and festive serving, and as a base for gift hampers. Wipe clean and oil lightly every few months.

title: Printed Mango Wood Trays with Brass Handles
description: Mango wood frame trays with printed bases in assorted designs, including mandala, peacock, tree of life and Egyptian motifs, fitted with brass handles. Available in several sizes for mixed shelf displays.

title: Mughal Tree of Life Tray & Organiser Set
description: Nesting square trays and a 2-compartment organiser printed with a Mughal arch and tree of life in soft pastels, framed by gold-embossed borders. Works as a serving set, a vanity set or a premium gift.

title: Floral Two-Tier Serving Stand
description: Two scalloped ceramic plates printed with Mughal-style florals and a mint green border, joined by a gold handle. For cakes, cookies and sweets at tea parties and festive tables.

title: Silver Dry-Fruit Jar Set with Tray
description: Four ribbed glass jars with silver lids topped by flower knobs, sitting on a beaded silver tray with handles. Made for dry fruits, sweets and mukhwas, and popular for Diwali and wedding gifting.

title: Ribbed Ceramic Mug Set
description: Ribbed ceramic mugs in soft shades, sold in sets. Good for gift shops, cafes and corporate kits, and they pair with our printed trays for a ready gift set.

title: Floral Tray & Canister Gift Set
description: A printed square tray with four ceramic canisters with wooden lids, in a Mughal floral print, packed in a satin-lined Divine Home gift box. Ready to give for Diwali, weddings and corporate occasions.

title: Leatherette Vanity Organiser
description: A woven-texture leatherette organiser with gold accents for makeup brushes, combs and cosmetics. Wipe-clean, available in three designs, and a steady seller for lifestyle and gift stores.

title: 8-Compartment Wooden Spice Box
description: A wooden masala box with eight compartments and a printed lid, for whole spices, herbs and seeds. A practical kitchen gift that sells all year.

title: Gold Wire Bread Basket
description: A gold-finish metal basket for bread, rolls and fruit, with a woven liner. Lifts a dining table or buffet counter, and suits homes, cafes and hotels.

title: Marble-Effect Resin Cake Stand with Server
description: A resin cake stand with a marble effect and gold legs, sold with a matching cake server. For birthdays, weddings and festive hosting, and for bakeries and cafes that want a premium display.

title: Sippers & Tumblers (Assorted)
description: Insulated tumblers, sippers and bottles in pastel and printed designs. Fast-moving everyday stock for gift shops, popular with students and office buyers, and easy to add to corporate kits.

title: Compact Mirrors (Assorted Designs)
description: Pocket compact mirrors in assorted printed and metallic designs. A popular return gift for weddings and events, a hamper filler and a quick-moving counter item.
